nodes.label: Beast and Fey Pets
nodes.rationale: Beast Pets (puppy, wolf pup, bear cub) and Fey Pets (pixie, dryad sprout, blink fox) companions.

nodes.label: Magical and Dragon Pets
nodes.rationale: Magical Pets (fairy, phoenix chick, imp) and Dragon Pets (hatchling, ember whelp, thunder drake).

nodes.label: Undead Construct and Misc Pets
nodes.rationale: Undead (zombie cat, skeleton dog), Construct (clockwork mouse, iron hawk) and Misc (treasure slime, mimic pup) pets.
